verdict.rationale: Next.js ships its own first-party routing, file-system routes plus the App Router, built directly into the framework. It is integrated with streaming and Suspense, layouts, code-defined routing rules and internationalized routing, and a hands-on team praised its filesystem routing and per-route code splitting. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party routing documentation beyond marketing-level summaries, and independent evidence that routing details work smoothly (one hands-on report notes scroll-restoration problems on routing).

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official first-party routing library that integrates seamlessly with the framework

citations.quote: Create routes using the file system, including support for more advanced routing patterns and UI layouts.
Instantly stream UI from the server, integrated with the App Router and React Suspense.
Use code to define routing and access rules for authentication, experimentation, and internationalization.
Add support for multiple languages with internationalized routing and localized content.
